q: What minimum area do the DOH guidelines give for a major operating room?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 (Surgical and Obstetrical Service)
n: Major OR: 33.45 m² (about 360 sq. ft). Remember this: "33.45 for the big two" — the major operating room and the delivery room are both 33.45 sq. m. Private and isolation rooms are 9.29; every bed elsewhere is 7.43; every bassinet 3.72. X-ray rooms grow by table: 7.5 → 14.0 → 20.25.

q: What minimum area applies to the delivery room?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 (Surgical and Obstetrical Service)
n: Same as the major OR: 33.45 m².

q: What is the minimum area of the recovery room and of the labor room with toilet?
n: Recovery 9.29 m²; labor room with toilet 9.29 m².

q: What is the minimum area of a private room with toilet?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 (Nursing Unit)
n: Private room and isolation room with toilet: 9.29 m² each.

q: What unit area applies per bed in semi-private rooms and male/female wards?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 and Note 4
n: 7.43 m² per bed includes the bed, an occasional visitor and passage for equipment.

q: What clear floor area per bassinet applies in the pathologic, premature and breastfeeding areas?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 (Nursery) and Note 7
n: 3.72 m² per bassinet; the nursery viewing area is 3.90 m².

q: What is the minimum area for each wheeled stretcher space?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 and Note 5
n: Wheeled stretcher area: 1.08 m² per stretcher.

q: What clear floor area per dental chair does Annex B require?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21 and Note 6
n: 8.36 m² per chair includes movement of persons and passage of equipment.

q: What is the minimum area of the clinical work area with sink in the hospital laboratory under Annex B?
n: Annex B: 10.00 m². The Level 1 checklist asks for 20.00 m² (secondary lab) and Level 2–3 for 60.00 m² (tertiary lab).

q: What room size does Annex B give for an X-ray room with a STATIONARY patient table?
n: No table 7.5; stationary table 14.0; tilting table 20.25.

q: Which X-ray room needs the LARGEST area under Annex B?
o: Room with a stationary patient table
Room equipped with a tilting patient table
Room not equipped with a table

q: Under the Level 2 and Level 3 floor-plan checklists, the tertiary clinical laboratory work area must be at least:
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-6b item 1.4.1.1; H-6c item 1.4.1.1
n: Level 1 secondary lab 20.00 m²; Level 2–3 tertiary lab 60.00 m².

q: A female ward will hold 12 beds. What is the minimum ward area using the DOH standard?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21, Note 4

q: A premature room will hold 8 bassinets. What is its minimum area?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex B (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 21, Note 7
